# Creatures contract (Art Pass 3 + 8 new mobs). Orchestrator-owned; agents do not edit this file.
Biome map (ring -> Config.World / data/Biomes id): ring1 = SnowyForest (ring 0), ring2 = FrozenLake (1), ring3 = MountainsCaves (2) "ruins/scrap" outskirts, ring4 = DeepTundra (3). Ring weights are arrays indexed ring+1.
Scrap Hounds ("pack flanking in ruins") spawn in ring 3 and prefer ruin/structure POIs if cheap; ring weight is the contract.

## Ownership (exclusive)
- AGENT 1: src/server/Mobs/** (MobService split, Species/, Behaviors), src/shared/Config/Mobs.luau, src/shared/data/Mobs.luau, src/shared/logic/Mob*.luau + new logic/MobBehaviors*.luau, Config/Items.luau + data/Items.luau + data/Recipes.luau + ItemCatalog (drops/recipes), DebugCommands + DebugService (/debug mob, /debug mobs), tests/Mob*Tests.luau, LivePartsTests if needed. Also the `Registry.attach` call in createMob and the SERVER side of State/Target attrs. Ambient cue plumbing (crows/wisps <- Dread/Stalker) reads server APIs only; may add a read-only accessor to DreadService/StalkerService/Isolation (additive, no behavior change).
- AGENT 2: src/shared/Creatures/AnimKit.luau, src/client/Art/CreatureAnim.luau, Defs/{ArcticHare,Caribou,Fish,Wolf,SnowGrouse,RidgeStag,LakeSeal,RimeWolverine}.luau, tests/AnimKitTests.luau (pure pose math; register in tests/run.luau).
- AGENT 3: Defs/{ScrapHound,CarrionCrow,FrostboundBrute,AuroraWisp,PolarBear,IceWraith,SnowLurker,CaveCrawler,IceWarden,CaveMatriarch,RuinColossus,WhiteoutBeast,Stalker,TreeWatcher,IceScratcher,EyesInDark}.luau, src/client/Art/CreatureFx.luau (crow flock visuals, wisp glow/trail/light, brute slam telegraph ring; exposes an idempotent non-yielding start(); the orchestrator calls it from MobsClient after launch), plus the one-line `Registry.attach(kind, root)` in StalkerService / LurkerService / HorrorWorld where those visuals are made (additive; keep behavior). Agent 3 must not edit MobService/BossService; Agent 1 attaches every MobService mob (incl. mini bosses, boss, hostiles).
- Orchestrator: Types, CreatureBuild, Registry, Config/Creatures.luau, stubs, MobsClient hook, docs/INTEGRATION.md, STATUS, HAND_TESTS_ROUND, ART_STATUS, ART.md, CREDITS. Agents do NOT touch these docs; put notes in your <=10-line report (hand-test hints, sound hook points, credits) and the orchestrator merges them.

## Rig / State (see src/shared/Creatures/Types.luau, Config.Creatures)
- Model (server-built): root `HumanoidRootPart` (hitbox, invisible after attach) + visual parts built ONLY via CreatureBuild.part (Motor6D "J_<part>", CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch false, Massless). <=25 BaseParts per model incl. root (Registry.attach asserts).
- Replicated model attributes: `State` (Idle Walk Run Alert Telegraph Attack Hurt Death), `Target` (UserId, absent if none), `TelegraphLeft` (seconds), optional `Heading` (Vector3). SERVER moves mobs and writes attributes only on change. CLIENT animates from State; no server animation cost, no remote per tick.
- Death: server sets State=Death, MobHealth 0 (existing flow) and keeps the model for Mobs.DeathRemoveDelay; client plays the fall/fade.
- Hurt: server sets State=Hurt for ~Config.Creatures.HurtSeconds then returns to the previous state (client also plays Hurt locally on MobHealth drop).
- Telegraph: server sets State=Telegraph + TelegraphLeft=<wind-up seconds> for the full wind-up; damage lands only after it and only if the target is still in reach (dodgeable). Same pattern as the wolf Windup (Config.Night.WindupSeconds); wolf maps Windup->Telegraph.
- Animation only within Config.Creatures.AnimRadius (120) of the camera, nearest MaxAnimated; far creatures freeze (no step cost). Near tier full rate, far tier AnimHz.
- AnimKit.bind(model, rig) -> {step(dt), unbind()}; generic gaits (Quad Biped Bird Seal Slither Float Flock) + telegraphPose/attackPose names + optional rig.custom. Defs are pure data + build(); no per-frame code in Defs except rig.custom.
- Creator Store assets: allowed only fully script-sanitised; record in docs/CREDITS.md via report. Default: Part-built, no assets. Silhouettes must read in moonlight/whiteout: strong value contrast vs snow, simple big shapes, rim/eye accents (no real lights except the wisp rule).
- Sounds: silent hooks only (ART.md hook points: footstep, growl/warning, attack, hurt, death, crow caw, wisp hum). Agents add AudioCues keys with empty ids only if AudioCues exists for that pattern; do not invent asset ids.

## Kinds (Registry keys, also Config.Mobs ids and model.Name)
Existing: ArcticHare Caribou Fish Wolf PolarBear IceWraith SnowLurker CaveCrawler IceWarden CaveMatriarch RuinColossus WhiteoutBeast (mini bosses: IceWarden CaveMatriarch RuinColossus; blizzard boss WhiteoutBeast); Stalker; lurker visuals TreeWatcher IceScratcher EyesInDark.
New: SnowGrouse RidgeStag LakeSeal RimeWolverine ScrapHound CarrionCrow FrostboundBrute AuroraWisp.

## Config.Mobs schema (AGENT 1), new `Species` table keyed by id; legacy Hare/Caribou/Wolf keep MobStats
SpeciesDef = { id: string, role: "passive"|"neutral"|"hostile"|"ambient", ringWeights: {number} (4 entries, ring+1), behaviors: {string}, health, damage, walkSpeed, runSpeed, hitsToKill (tunable target using starting-tool damage; order grouse<hare<stag<seal<wolverine<wolf<hounds<brute, tested), telegraphSeconds, drops: {{id, min, max, chance}}, partCap (<=25), spawnCap (live per species), packSize? , aggroRange, attackRange, attackCooldown, fleeRange, hitRadius, hostileWeightPerRing? (outer rings meaner: more hostile weight + gentle capped scaling through existing Scaling caps; MaxLiveMobs 40 stays) }.
Item ids/stacks (Config.Items): Feather 20, Venison 10 (food), Blubber 10 (fuel), Claw 10, Fang 10, Bone 10, DenseHide 10, CrystalShard 10, AuroraDust 10 (+ existing RawMeat/Hide); each with >=1 use (fuel/food/craft/coin value) and 3-4 recipes (insulated clothing from Feather+Hide, blubber torch, etc.). Agent 1 may rename drops, keep roles.
## Behavior interface (AGENT 1; pure, no Roblox APIs, src/shared/logic/MobBehaviors*.luau, each a small state machine with step(state, inputs, dt) -> (newState, outputs), headless-tested)
Flee, ReturnAfterFlee, Retaliate, TerritorialWarn, HerdAlert, PackFlank, Telegraph, Circle, Lure. Server species modules in src/server/Mobs/Species/<Kind>.luau compose them and map outputs to State attrs.
## Dread hooks (AGENT 1)
Ambient mobs (CarrionCrow, AuroraWisp) deal no damage (wisp: small warmth drain on touch, capped). Spawn weight is a pure function of isolation/party size (Isolation logic): lone players attract more, full groups suppress; crows circle then scatter toward the Stalker's hunting direction (Heading attr from StalkerService.isHunting direction accessor); wisps drift toward hazards and lure off-path. No visible meters.
## Counting / spawning (AGENT 1)
Mob parts counted against Perf.MaxLiveParts 6000 (stays 6000; use PerfBudget/LivePartsTests pattern). Spawn lazily near players; never inside structure footprints (existing spawnBlocker) nor on ungrounded sites (GroundProbe/SiteGround). Existing mob behavior unchanged (MobTests/sim must still pass).
## Done
Each agent: scripts/check.sh passes; no playtests/QA/commits; no MCP unless essential (code-only round); report <=10 lines (files, check, open issues, hand-test hints, sound hooks, credits).
